name: Soul of the Paladin
body:
Associated Skills: Diplomacy, Intimidate, Knowledge (religion), Ride

Associated Veils: Angelic Wings, Banelight Vortices, Belt of Woven Gold, Criniere of Warding, Halo of Holy Light, Unicorn’s Barding, Vambraces of Holy Scripture, White Rider’s Sash

Lay on Hands (Su)

At 1st level, tapping into the soul of the paladin allows you to call upon their holy powers to heal with but a touch. You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 1 + your Wisdom modifier + 1 per 2 soulforge levels beyond 1st. With a touch, you can heal a living creature for 1d6 points of damage + 1d6 points per 2 soulforge levels beyond 1st. Using this ability is a standard action, or a swift action when using it on yourself. This healing is considered to be derived from positive energy. Alternatively, you can use this ability to damage creatures harmed by positive energy as a melee touch attack made as a standard action. On a successful hit, it deals the above healing as damage that bypasses any immunities or resistances.

Aura of Courage (Su)

At 3rd level, the soul of the paladin imbues you with great courage that radiates outwards, granting you immunity to fear, and grants all of your allies within 10 feet a +1 morale bonus on saving throws against fear effects. This ability only functions while you are conscious. This bonus increases by an additional +1 at 5th, 11th, and 17th level.

Divine Health (Ex)

At 5th level, the soul of the paladin imbues you with holy power, granting you immunity to diseases, including supernatural diseases. If you were afflicted with a disease when you forged this soul, its effects are suppressed for as long as the soul is forged. The disease still progresses, allowing you to make Fortitude saves to fight it off, but you suffer no penalties on a failed save. You still suffer from any ability score damage or other penalties inflicted on you by the disease before you forged this soul.

Mercy (Su)

At 5th level, and every 3 levels thereafter, you may select a paladin’s mercy to affect your lay on hands.

This functions as the paladin ability of the same name, save that you use your soulforge level as your effective paladin level for the ability.
